barriers.title: Tritium Scarcity
barriers.detail: ~25kg global supply. Lithium blanket breeding unproven at commercial scale.

barriers.title: Materials Degradation
barriers.detail: Neutron bombardment degrades structural components faster than fission. No material validated for full commercial duty cycle. EU €340M research program launched Jan 2026.

barriers.title: Timeline Slippage History
barriers.detail: ITER over $22B and years behind. Fusion timelines have historically slipped by 5-10 years across all major programs.

barriers.title: Net Energy Positive at Grid Scale
barriers.detail: NIF achieved ignition in 2022 but energy output was laser-input dependent. Commercial energy positive remains undemonstrated at utility scale.

milestone_banner.text: DOE approved Xcimer's laser fusion power plant design on Aug 29, 2026, while updated US roadmap targets commercial fusion deployment by mid-2030s as KSTAR achieved 48-second plasma hold at 100M degrees in June.
milestone_banner.highlight: DOE approved Xcimer's laser fusion power plant design

kstar.name: KSTAR
kstar.description: KSTAR achieved 48-second plasma hold at 100 million degrees in its full tungsten environment as of June 2026. The facility has surpassed 20,000 experiments and continues advancing toward its 300-second plasma hold target.

cfs.name: Commonwealth Fusion
cfs.description: CFS completed $1B funding round bringing total capital to $4B, with SPARC construction continuing at Devens facility toward 2027 first plasma. Five peer-reviewed papers validating ARC physics published while Chesterfield, Virginia commercial plant site advances.

helion.name: Helion Energy
helion.description: Helion continues advancing Polaris construction after achieving 150M°C plasma milestone in February 2026. Company is pursuing OpenAI power deal alongside existing Microsoft PPA while targeting 2028 first electricity generation.

tae.name: TAE Technologies / TMTG
tae.description: TAE-TMTG $6B merger continues with mid-2026 close target as parties finalize SEC S-4 review. TAE secured strategic Helium-3 supply agreement with Black Moon Energy Corporation to support future fusion commercialization.

iter.name: ITER
iter.description: ITER Council confirms continued progress across construction, commissioning, and licensing activities. Assembly advances with six of nine tokamak sectors installed, maintaining trajectory toward 2027 first plasma.

east.name: EAST / China Program
east.description: EAST tokamak exceeded the Greenwald density limit in January 2026, achieving plasma densities previously considered theoretically impossible. China maintains global leadership in high-density sustained plasma research under its $1.5B fusion program.

timeline.title: Merger Announced
timeline.detail: All-stock deal signed. Boards approved. DJT stock +33% on day of.

timeline.title: $200M Cash to TAE at Signing
timeline.detail: Additional $100M available on SEC Form S-4 filing.

timeline.title: Shareholder + Regulatory Close
timeline.detail: SEC S-4 review ongoing. Truth Social spinoff cancelled; integrated company structure confirmed. Jeff Woodbury appointed TAE President/COO. Trump Jr. joins board. Mid-2026 close target reaffirmed. TAE secured strategic Helium-3 supply agreement with Black Moon Energy Corporation.

timeline.title: Plant Site Selection Begins
timeline.detail: Nunes stated site search begins after deal closes.
